elements.label: Run progress bar reaching 100%
elements.change_other: progress fill completes; bar switches from light partial fill to solid blue with 100% label

elements.label: Newest status log row appended at top of table
Current run row in Pending/Recent Runs list (status icon updates)

pattern.description: Screen-recorded integration run finishes: the progress bar snaps to 100%, a Success check appears, a final log line is pushed onto the status table and the run's list icon updates, all within about 200 ms.
pattern.why_premium: Lets the real product state change carry the beat (job finished) in sync with the narration moving on, giving visible proof of the automation without added motion graphics.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.to(progressFill, {scaleX: 1, transformOrigin: 'left', duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'}); then gsap.fromTo([successIcon, successLabel], {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: 'none'}); gsap.fromTo(logRows, {y: -rowH}, {y: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power1.out'}) with the new top row fading in; swap list icon at the same time.
build_hint.remotion: interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [partial, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) for the bar scaleX; Success opacity interpolate over 4 frames; log rows translateY from -rowH to 0 over 4 frames; icon swap as a hard switch on the same frame.

notes: Filmstrip frames are very small; the exact changing items are inferred from candidate changed_share and the before/after status panel (partial vs full progress bar). The left-list change in b03 may be only a selection highlight or icon swap. Hard UI state change, likely step timing rather than eased motion. No SFX candidates.
